note: Simple Less (ipless) compiles .less files declared under a 'less:' key in *.libraries.yml into CSS using wikimedia/less.php, writing output to public://ipless/. It has NO config entity of its own: its four boolean flags live in core's system.performance config under an 'ipless' mapping (enabled, modedev, sourcemap, watch_mode), added via hook_config_schema_info_alter and surfaced on the Performance form (configure route system.performance_settings). On a fresh install the 'ipless' key is absent (all getters treat missing as FALSE). Compilation runs in HtmlResponseIplessSubscriber (kernel.response prio 4); a full rebuild is flagged by state key ipless.force_rebuild. Drush: ipless:generate (alias ipless). Service: ipless.base (Drupal\ipless\Ipless). Event: ipless.file_compilation. Hook: hook_less_alter. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the real system.performance ipless.* flags.

evals.prompt: Using the Simple Less (ipless) Drupal module, how do I tell Drupal to compile a Less file from my theme, and where does the compiled CSS end up? Show the libraries.yml syntax.
evals.expected_output: Declare the file under a 'less:' key in your *.libraries.yml (e.g. less: { theme: { css/styles.less: { output: css/gen/styles.css } } }). With compilation enabled, ipless compiles it via wikimedia/less.php to public://ipless/{extension}-{library}--{file}.css and injects it as the library's css.

evals.prompt: I installed the Simple Less (ipless) module but there is no dedicated settings page for it. Where do I enable Less compilation, and in which core configuration object are its settings stored?
evals.expected_output: There is no config entity of its own; ipless adds its options to the core Performance page (/admin/config/development/performance, route system.performance_settings). The flags are stored in the system.performance config under an 'ipless' mapping: ipless.enabled, ipless.modedev, ipless.sourcemap, ipless.watch_mode.

evals.prompt: Which Drush command does the Simple Less (ipless) module provide to precompile all Less stylesheets across the site, and what is its alias?
evals.expected_output: drush ipless:generate (alias: drush ipless) — it calls Ipless::generateAllLibraries() to compile every installed module/theme library's Less into public://ipless/.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, is Simple Less (ipless) compilation currently enabled, and is its developer (recompile-on-every-request) mode on or off? Inspect the live configuration to answer.
evals.expected_output: Reading system.performance: ipless.enabled is TRUE (compilation is enabled) but ipless.modedev is FALSE, so developer mode is OFF.

evals.prompt: The Simple Less (ipless) module is set up on this site. Inspect the live system.performance configuration and state whether watch mode (live CSS refresh) is currently active.
evals.expected_output: In system.performance, ipless.modedev is TRUE and ipless.watch_mode is TRUE, so watch mode is active (it only takes effect when developer mode is also on).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, enable Simple Less (ipless) CSS compilation by setting the ipless.enabled flag in the system.performance configuration to true. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set system.performance -> ipless.enabled to TRUE (e.g. drush cset system.performance ipless.enabled 1, or tick 'Less compilation enabled' on the Performance page and save).

evals.prompt: I set up my theme to use Less stylesheets with the Simple Less module, but the styles aren't compiling. Please switch on Less compilation for my site so the .less files get turned into CSS.
evals.expected_output: Same end state as the expert phrasing: system.performance -> ipless.enabled becomes TRUE (turn on 'Less compilation enabled' on the Performance page / set the config flag).
